projects.publication_policy: tracked publishable files only; registered loan-level data excluded
tracked publishable files only; large raw, intermediate, analytical, and parquet result files excluded

Dataset remains tracked MIT-licensed code and documentation only; market data, derived tables, fitted states, run bundles, ingestion authorities, and local environments excluded. A separate bounded PUBLIC_DERIVED_ONLY summary is hosted only by the website and Space.

notes: CasualLab and Macroeconomics retain their prior clean research payloads. RealEstate includes tracked publishable source, tests, synthetic fixtures, documentation, and aggregate reports while excluding registered Freddie Mac records and loan-granular derivatives. TariffIncidence includes 122 tracked source, test, configuration, manifest, documentation, fixture, dashboard, and narrative report files while excluding large raw, intermediate, analytical, and parquet result files. Microstructure adds 133 tracked code, test, configuration, and documentation files while excluding exchange observations, normalized and derived tables, fitted states, ingestion authorities, generated run bundles, and local environments. Its machine-generated exploratory summary is a separate website/Space asset and is not part of this Dataset release.
